name: ubiquiti-unifi-client-devices
description: Parses UniFi Network client-device events (WiFi/wired client connected, disconnected, roamed, blocked) shipped as CEF over syslog. The regex captures only the CEF envelope (linear, ReDoS-safe); the engine's CEF extension parser explodes the key=value pairs, and derivations map them to canonical fields. Connect events name the AP as UNIFIconnectedTo*, disconnect events as UNIFIlastConnectedTo* — both are mapped onto the same ap_* fields so a query does not have to know which. Requires the extension to start with UNIFIcategory=Client Devices (the discriminator vs. the Security and Audit parsers). The syslog time/host prefix is optional so the header-stripped message SIEMBox stores also matches.
